title: RabbitMQ: Exchanges, Routing, Acks
definition: Smart message broker that routes messages from producers through exchanges and bindings into queues, providing fine-grained consumer acknowledgments, QoS prefetch, and dead-letter fault isolation.

keyPoints.title: Exchanges & Topic Routing
keyPoints.description: Direct, Fanout, and Topic wildcard patterns (*, #) decouple publishers from subscriber queues so new consumers join without changing producer code.

keyPoints.title: Consumer Acks & DLX
keyPoints.description: Manual acknowledgments (ack/nack) prevent message loss during worker crashes, while dead letter exchanges isolate unprocessable poison messages.

keyPoints.title: Prefetch & Fair QoS
keyPoints.description: Consumer prefetch limits unacknowledged in-flight messages, preventing slow workers from starvation while fast workers stay fully utilized.

recap: RabbitMQ me producer message seedha queue me nahi, exchange ko bhejta hai. Exchange type tay karta hai ki message kaise baantega: Direct exact match dekhta hai, Fanout bina key dekhe sabhi queues ko broadcast karta hai, aur Topic wildcards (*, #) se pattern match karta hai. Consumer processing ke baad manual ack dekar message loss rokta hai, jabki prefetch fast aur slow workers me fair dispatch banata hai aur DLX poison messages ko safely isolate karta hai.
